note: v1, written: THE ROOM TURNS. Lo-fi deep house (the style board's t17 row), 122 -> 120 bpm (the ramp in the last 32 bars), D minor (7A). 5:17. The featured illusion is THE ROOM THAT TURNS (precedence / Haas): a swung loop of rims and shaker on the 16ths, played by four dusty-kit tracks - a left-leading pair (the right side 18 ms late) and a right-leading pair (the reverse) - crossfaded by complementary 6-bar sine LFOs. The ear follows the leading side, so the loop circles the head while its level never changes (left/right within 1.3 dB bar by bar). Under the break, a BINAURAL BEAT: D3 in the left ear, 5 Hz higher in the right, beating inside the head. A dusty kit (the kick straight, the hats, shaker and clap swung 0.6), lazy Rhodes ninths (Dm9 - Bbmaj7 - Gm9 - A7sus(b9)) through a 5-bar low-pass LFO with THE STAIR (D E F A) on top, vinyl crackle, a round sub pumped from the kick. Stepped section lanes: intro -14.5, A -11.4, break -19.9, B -11.0, outro -13.8 dB. Seams per the mix plan: in over a held D2 (t16's outro at 122), out over a held D2 into t18 at 120. Master: -11.1 LUFS, true peak -1.29 dBTP, levels 100 (pinned runs 1-2). compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 87.908/87.966/87.906/84.505. The draft's 150 and 290 Hz peaks (Rhodes and stair register, +17 and +14 dB) were notched and the top brought up (spectrum 57 -> 90). The rhythm term reads 56 because its tempo estimate lands on the true 122 grid, where these swung 16ths sit; a crisp machine-kit tick layer didn't move it (parked, C7T17_TICK).

note: v2, written: TURNING AGAINST THE BAR. The turning loop (still circling the head by precedence) is now a dotted-eighth cycle: a rim or shaker on every third 16th, running across the bar lines. It turns in space and against the four-on-the-floor at once. The lazy Rhodes moves onto the 'a' of 1 and 3 (16ths 3 and 11), the sub answers on 9 and 11, and the groove leans and rolls instead of sitting on the eighths. The halves are distinct: A2 opens every off-beat hat and adds a third stab; the clap arrives with A; B2 breathes four bars without the kick. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: v1 87.908/87.966/87.906/84.505 -> v2 92.792/92.802/92.767/92.776 (rhythm 56 -> 100, off-grid share 0.0 -> 0.32; structure 91 on every seed). Why v1 read 56: compscore's onset envelope runs at 46.9 frames/s, so at 122 bpm a 16th is 5.8 frames and never forms its own peak; only lags off the eighth grid (the dotted-eighth's 17.3 frames) count. The loop's 3/16 cycle alone didn't register; with the syncopated Rhodes it did. Taking the Rhodes out of the intro and outro lost it again (87.8). Levels: -11.1 LUFS, true peak -1.29 dBTP, pinned run 1.
next: spectrum 87 (the loop's rims forward); flow 50 (t16's outro and t18).
